originality.rationale: The existing 2008 Hamming-two totals 136/88/120 are explicitly acknowledged; the precise new statement is that no two edges share a vertex and the full positional-gap histograms, which those totals do not imply. value.rationale: Valid-to-valid pair swaps are the elementary move motivating earlier Costas heuristic searches. This complete finite obstruction shows no third valid state is reachable by repeated swaps in three consecutive natural orders. The order-eleven counterboundary and exact physical column-gap spectra add structural and algorithmic content beyond preexisting pair counts; no broad-n extrapolation is claimed.
